labelDefinition: the run's actual direction over the next 6 bars (packages/ml-engine/src/cycle/labels.py actual_direction): 1 when close[t+6] - close[t] is above 0 ticks, 0 when below minus that; a bar inside the threshold, whose horizon crosses a session gap or the fold end, or where the model made no call is unlabelled

cost.source: config.json plan.costModel, the run's own copy of packages/config/cost_model.json:MNQ (2.80 US dollars per round trip per contract)

interval.method: causal conformal: probability_up binned into trailing deciles, empirical quantiles of realized forward return per bin, refreshed on a fixed step using only rows whose horizon has already elapsed

attribution.reason: the Model Cycle record keeps the explainer's inputs (explain/), not per-bar attributions; the Inside view on the Model Cycle page computes them

notes: Read from the Model Cycle run's own record: 493 test bars across 1 walk-forward fold, laid end to end in the order the model walked them. Prices are the ones the run traded, as recorded (the plan names no roll adjustment).

A bar is labelled only where the run scored it: its 6-bar horizon resolved inside the same fold, did not cross a session gap, moved past the label threshold, and the model made a call. 484 of 493 bars qualify (the run's scoreboard counts 484).

Trades here follow the lens rule, not the run's: enter at the close of a bar whose P(up) clears the threshold (short when it is at or below one minus it), exit at the close 6 rows later, one trade at a time, charged 1.40 points per round trip. The run's own rule was: long when P(up) >= 0.55, short when P(up) <= 0.45, decided at a bar's close and filled at the next bar's open; a 6-bar holding period that renews while the call holds; an opposite call reverses at the next open. So the lens trade count and net profit are the lens rule's own; the direction scoreboard (hit rate, area under the curve, Brier score) is the run's and must match it.
Under its own rule the run closed 12 trades for -$490.60 net (scoreboard.json; every trade in trades.parquet and on the Model Cycle page).
The run was stopped before it finished; the record holds the bars it walked.
